## LLM-generated summary

Thomas Nield's *Essential Math for Data Science* reviews the calculus, probability, statistics, and linear algebra that sit under everyday data work, then connects them to linear and logistic regression and related machine-learning practice. It is a practitioner-oriented refresher with code, not a proof-heavy mathematics text. The aim is to make model-fitting and evaluation less of a black box for people who already write some code.
